description: This file contains functions and types for configuring plugins via UI hints, including discovery, prompting, and setup workflows for plugins with configurable fields in a wizard interface.

methods.name: resolveJsonSchemaProperty
methods.description: Resolves a JSON schema property for a given field key within a schema.

methods.name: getExistingPluginConfig
methods.description: Retrieves existing plugin configuration from the overall config for a specific plugin ID.

methods.name: formatCurrentValue
methods.description: Formats a value into a string for display purposes.

methods.name: discoverConfigurablePlugins
methods.description: Discovers plugins with non-advanced UI hints that are promptable.

methods.name: discoverUnconfiguredPlugins
methods.description: Discovers plugins with unconfigured promptable fields for onboarding.

methods.name: promptPluginFields
methods.description: Prompts the user to configure plugin fields via UI hints and updates the config.

methods.name: setupPluginConfig
methods.description: Runs the plugin setup wizard to configure selected plugins.

methods.name: configurePluginConfig
methods.description: Runs the plugin configuration wizard to modify plugin settings.
